relationships.subject: morphine
relationships.evidence_quote: Morphine and fentanyl activated NLRP3 inflammasome in astrocytes and serotonergic (TPH-2-positive) neurons, but fentanyl effects were more pronounced.

relationships.subject: fentanyl
relationships.evidence_quote: Morphine and fentanyl activated NLRP3 inflammasome in astrocytes and serotonergic (TPH-2-positive) neurons, but fentanyl effects were more pronounced.

relationships.subject: MCC950
relationships.evidence_quote: The anti-inflammatory agent minocycline and the NLRP3 inhibitor MCC950 delayed tolerance to morphine and fentanyl antinociception and prevented fentanyl-induced hyperalgesia.

key_findings: Morphine and fentanyl induce cell-specific NLRP3 inflammasome activation and pyroptosis in the DRN via TLR4 in astrocytes and opioid receptors in neurons.
MCC950 delayed opioid tolerance and prevented fentanyl hyperalgesia.
